IA.name: Information architecture
IA.question: Can a reader predict where something lives, reach it from the index, and follow a sequence without dead ends?

ON.name: Onboarding
ON.question: Does a first-time visitor know who the site is for and what to open first within 30 seconds?

FV.name: First visit
FV.question: Does anything look broken, raw, empty or untrue before the reader has read a word?

PQ.name: Page quality
PQ.question: Does every page of the same type behave the same way, and is the copy clean?

PR.name: Production readiness
PR.question: Would this survive being shared on LinkedIn, indexed by Google and read on a phone?

CT.name: Content coverage
CT.question: Does the site cover the evaluation surface end to end, tie it to runnable code, and keep its core strengths?

verify_methods.read: a person or subagent reads the pages
verify_methods.fetch: fetch a specific URL and look at status or content
verify_methods.repo: run a free repo script or read the source under docs/ and site/build.py

checks.title: Top nav has 6 or fewer items
checks.pass_when: The header shows at most 6 section links (brand, contents toggle and theme controls excluded)

checks.title: Every page reachable from the index in one click
checks.pass_when: Every crawled page is linked from the index page; no orphan pages

checks.title: No broken internal links
checks.pass_when: Every internal link returns 200 and every #fragment exists on its target page

checks.title: One name per thing
checks.pass_when: The index card title, the page <title> and the page H1 use the same words for each page

checks.title: Sequences have prev and next
checks.pass_when: Every roadmap explainer (Level 0-10) and every interactive lab (01-05) links to its previous and next page

checks.title: Deliberate duplicates are declared and cross-linked
checks.pass_when: Overlapping pages (question bank and drill, roadmap and explainers, OpenAI audit and tutorial, field guide and explainers) say what each is for and link each other both ways

checks.title: Theory links to its practice
checks.pass_when: Each explainer and theory page links to the lab, drill section or notebook that practises it, and the lab links back

checks.title: One URL scheme
checks.pass_when: All page URLs are lowercase-kebab slugs under one pattern; no spaces, underscores, uppercase or nested legacy paths

checks.title: Retired URLs redirect permanently
checks.pass_when: Every retired URL returns 301/308 to its new page (not 404, not the index). na until a page is renamed or removed

checks.title: Site search
checks.pass_when: A search box or Cmd-K finds pages and sections by keyword (e.g. 'faithfulness', 'release gate')

checks.title: References link to site pages, not repo paths or GitHub copies
checks.pass_when: Every mention of another document that is on the site is a link to its site page; no docs/… paths as plain text, no GitHub source-view links where a site page exists, no references to files the site does not serve

checks.title: Homepage says who it is for and where to start
checks.pass_when: Above the fold: the audience, the promise, and one primary call to action (at most one secondary)

checks.title: One recommended path, consistent everywhere
checks.pass_when: The index, the roadmap, the study plan and Level 0 recommend the same order and link to each other; no two start pages disagree

checks.title: Effort shown and consistent
checks.pass_when: Pages and paths show a time estimate, and hours for the roadmap, study plan and fast path agree wherever they appear

checks.title: Prerequisites stated
checks.pass_when: Each explainer and lab says what to know first, or which level comes before it

checks.title: Express lane for interview-soon readers
checks.pass_when: A link on the index takes an 'interview this week' reader straight to the fast path, drill or question bank

checks.title: Path to the runnable course is clear
checks.pass_when: The index links to the repository and says which course and setup to use to run the notebooks

checks.title: Diagrams render after load
checks.pass_when: No raw Mermaid source (e.g. 'flowchart LR', 'graph TD') is visible 4 seconds after load; every diagram is an SVG

checks.title: Interactive labs respond on first load
checks.pass_when: On every lab, moving the control changes the metric numbers, and the console shows no errors

checks.title: The drill works for a new visitor
checks.pass_when: Answers start hidden, reveal works, rating and the weak-only filter work, with no saved progress needed

checks.title: Counts on the index and blurbs are true
checks.pass_when: Claimed counts (questions, cases, levels, labs, stages, gotchas, TODOs, sections) match what the pages contain

checks.title: No stub or placeholder pages
checks.pass_when: No published page under 300 words (labs excepted) and no TODO, TBD, lorem ipsum or Coming soon text

checks.title: No build internals on the index
checks.pass_when: The index shows readers content, not build bookkeeping (docs/ file paths, skip lists, generator notes)

checks.title: Every page carries the site navigation
checks.pass_when: Rendered and copied pages both link back to the index and to every top-nav section

checks.title: Copied pages match the site's look
checks.pass_when: Standalone HTML pages (labs, drill, study plan, tutorial) use the same fonts, colours and header as rendered pages, in light and dark

checks.title: Reading time on content pages
checks.pass_when: Every rendered and standalone reading page shows one reading time

checks.title: Long pages have on-page contents
checks.pass_when: Every page over 2,000 words has a contents rail, collapsible sections, or both

checks.title: Explainers follow the house format
checks.pass_when: Every roadmap explainer has imperative section headings, a worked example, Key Takeaways, Check Yourself and References

checks.title: No build artefacts in page text
checks.pass_when: No 'Generated from' footers, raw docs/*.md paths in prose, or links to .md files used as navigation

checks.title: No copy bugs
checks.pass_when: No doubled words, visible HTML entities (·, &), mojibake, placeholders, or claims that contradict the list beneath them

checks.title: One spelling system
checks.pass_when: US or UK spelling used consistently across the site

checks.title: Diagrams and tables fit the column
checks.pass_when: No diagram or table forces horizontal page scroll; wide ones scroll inside their own box or scale

checks.title: Author and last-updated date on content pages
checks.pass_when: Every content page shows an author or maintainer and a last-updated date

checks.title: Custom domain
checks.pass_when: Served from its own domain; the vercel.app host redirects to it

checks.title: Share preview image
checks.pass_when: og:title, og:description and og:image (1200x630) on every page; twitter:card summary_large_image

checks.title: Canonical tag on every page
checks.pass_when: <link rel=canonical> on every page, pointing at itself

checks.title: Privacy-friendly analytics
checks.pass_when: An analytics script loads (e.g. Vercel Web Analytics, Plausible)

checks.title: About and author
checks.pass_when: A page or index section says who maintains the site, their background in evaluation, and how to reach them

checks.title: Edit-on-GitHub or feedback link
checks.pass_when: Every content page links to its source Markdown on GitHub or to an issue form

checks.title: Custom 404 with navigation
checks.pass_when: Unknown URLs return HTTP 404 with the site header and links back to the index sections

checks.title: robots.txt and sitemap present
checks.pass_when: robots.txt returns 200 and names the sitemap; sitemap.xml returns 200 and lists every page

checks.title: Sitemap complete, with lastmod
checks.pass_when: The sitemap lists exactly the crawled pages and every entry has lastmod. na while there is no sitemap (PR-08 carries that)

checks.title: Favicon, lang, description, one H1 per page
checks.pass_when: All four on every page

checks.title: Mobile layout works at 390 px
checks.pass_when: No horizontal page scroll at 390 px on the index, an explainer, the question bank, a lab and the drill; nav usable

checks.title: Fast first byte
checks.pass_when: Median time to first byte under 800 ms over repeat loads

checks.title: Structured data
checks.pass_when: LearningResource or Article JSON-LD on content pages

checks.title: Derived material credited and cleared
checks.pass_when: Pages built on third-party material (OpenAI guide, FDE playbook, DeepLearning.AI x Arize labs) credit the source and the owner confirms the use is permitted

checks.title: Public changelog or last-deployed date
checks.pass_when: A dated changelog, or a site-wide last-updated date, is linked from the index or footer

checks.title: Drill progress persists and resets safely
checks.pass_when: Drill ratings survive a reload, and clearing them asks for confirmation

checks.title: Lighthouse 90+ on five page types
checks.pass_when: Performance, accessibility, best practices and SEO each 90+ on the index, an explainer, the question bank, a lab and the drill

checks.title: Security headers
checks.pass_when: Framing blocked, HSTS, X-Content-Type-Options and a content security policy present

checks.title: Third-party scripts pinned
checks.pass_when: Every CDN script URL names an exact version (e.g. mermaid@11.4.1, not mermaid@11)

checks.title: Evaluation surface covered end to end
checks.pass_when: Retrieval, generation, tool use, trajectory, multi-turn, LLM judges, human labels, statistics, release gate/CI, online evaluation and safety each have a substantive section

checks.title: Every roadmap level has its explainer
checks.pass_when: Eleven explainer pages, Level 0 to Level 10, all published (guards a core strength)

checks.title: Explainers point to runnable code
checks.pass_when: Every explainer links to the notebook(s) or lab that implement it

checks.title: All four frameworks shown in use
checks.pass_when: DeepEval, RAGAS, MLflow 3 GenAI and Arize Phoenix each appear with a concrete example or code, not only a mention

checks.title: Six interactive labs present
checks.pass_when: The surface map and Labs 01-05 are published (guards a core strength)

checks.title: Drill in sync with the question bank
checks.pass_when: python3 .github/scripts/check_drill_sync.py exits 0 on the deployed commit

checks.title: Worked examples with numbers
checks.pass_when: Every explainer and theory page has at least one worked example with concrete inputs and metric values

checks.title: Failure modes named for each metric family
checks.pass_when: Each metric family says what it misses or how it lies (e.g. faithfulness 1.00 on a false answer), not only how to compute it

checks.title: Self-check on every explainer
checks.pass_when: Every explainer ends with Check Yourself questions whose answers are hidden until revealed

checks.title: Library APIs on the site match the pinned versions
checks.pass_when: No retired API names (e.g. LLMTestCaseParams in GEval, ragas.metrics imports of moved metrics) shown as current; code matches deepeval 4.2.3 / ragas 0.4.3 / mlflow 3

checks.title: Production and organisational side covered
checks.pass_when: Online evaluation, monitoring, cost and guardrails, sign-off and ownership each have material a practitioner can act on

checks.title: Every tracked docs/ file is published or deliberately skipped
checks.pass_when: Each git-tracked file under docs/ appears in RENDER, COPY or SKIP in site/build.py, and the build fails when one does not

C1.title: No visible author, About or update dates

C3.title: Theory not tied to runnable code

S1.title: Findability: broken links, orphans, no search

S3.title: Two page families (rendered vs copied) behave differently
